`35-38`: **Seed generated tensors for reproducible correctness results.**

Unseeded randomness can cause non-reproducible failures near tolerance thresholds.

 

<details>
<summary>Proposed reproducibility patch</summary>

```diff
-def generate_random_inputs(batch_size, device="cuda"):
-    hidden_states = torch.randn(batch_size, HIDDEN_SIZE, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)

+def generate_random_inputs(batch_size, device="cuda", seed=0):
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=device)
+    gen.manual_seed(seed + batch_size)
+    hidden_states = torch.randn(
+        batch_size, HIDDEN_SIZE, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device, generator=gen
+    )
+    weight = torch.randn(HIDDEN_SIZE, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device, generator=gen)
     return {"hidden_states": hidden_states, "weight": weight}
```
